title: oppersite mirrors
style: Upbeat swing-revival track in G major at 180 BPM. The arrangement features a walking upright bass line, a driving drum kit with prominent ride cymbal and snare rimshots, and a bright brass section including trumpets and trombones playing staccato stabs. A clean-toned hollow-body electric guitar provides rhythmic comping. Baritone male vocals deliver a call-and-response style performance with energetic, shouted ad-libs. The brass section plays syncopated riffs between vocal phrases, while the piano adds occasional bluesy fills in the upper register.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[upright bass walking line, swing drums with ride cymbal, brass stabs]

[Chorus]
[baritone male vocals]
Opposites attract
Get it! [brass riff]
Get it down, down, down
They're each high
You said low
Like a damn seesaw
At the Royal Show
Get it! [brass riff]
Get it down, down, down
Smash is on its way
Set it low every day
Get it! [brass riff]
Get it down, down, down

[Verse 1]
Opposites attract
Opponents struggling
Caught at their feet
Have no fear
It's an easy beat
The street's in low
You said high
Snap up that little baby
Right out of the sky

[Chorus]
Opposites attract
Get it! [brass riff]
Get it down, down, down
They reach high
You said low
Like a damn seesaw
At the Royal Show
[brass section solo, drums continue driving swing feel]
